caption:
A DC-3. On floats. ✈️

N130Q started life in 1943 as a C-53D Skytrooper. Maine aviators Dick and Max Folsom turned it into an amphibian, and it first flew on floats in 1990. This September it was back over Moosehead Lake for Greenville’s International Seaplane Fly-In.

Now the Maine Center for Classic Aviation is raising $100,000 to buy an ownership stake and help keep the world’s only flying DC-3 on amphibious floats airworthy and based in Maine. The group hopes to bring it to Oshkosh someday. Two radials and a pair of floats on the same arrival? That’s a flight line we’d love to see.

Sources: AVweb, Nov. 18, 2026, and the Maine Center for Classic Aviation campaign.
